fireball_flat.label: $t$ and $r$
caption: The plane of $t$ and $r$ ($\theta = \pi/2$, $\varphi = 0$), with $\tau_1 = 0.8\,\tau_\infty$. The fireball fills the region between the light cone of the origin, $r = ct$, and the hyperbola $\tau = \tau_1$ on which creation ends. Every null ray is a straight line at 45°.

expansion_flat.label: $t$ and $r$
caption: The plane of $t$ and $r$ ($\theta = \pi/2$, $\varphi = 0$), with $\tau_1 = 0.8\,\tau_\infty$. The free expansion fills the region above the hyperbola $\tau = \tau_1$, where it joins the fireball. Every null ray is a straight line at 45°.

outside_flat.label: $t$ and $r$
caption: The plane of $t$ and $r$ ($\theta = \pi/2$, $\varphi = 0$). Flat space is empty outside the light cone of the origin, $r = ct$, and the universe grows inside it.

fireball_proper.label: $T$ and $\chi$
caption: The plane of $T$ and $\chi$ ($\theta = \pi/2$, $\varphi = 0$), up to the end of creation ($HT_1 = 2\ln 3$). Null rays conserve $\eta \pm \chi$ with $\eta = \ln\tanh(HT/2)$, which diverges at $T = 0$: a ray from any $\chi$ reaches the world line $\chi = 0$.

expansion_proper.label: $T$ and $\chi$
caption: The plane of $T$ and $\chi$ ($\theta = \pi/2$, $\varphi = 0$), from the end of creation ($HT_1 = 2\ln 3$). Null rays conserve $\eta \pm \chi$ with $\cosh(\eta - \eta_b) = (T - T_b)/b$.

fireball_conformal.label: $\eta$ and $\chi$
caption: The plane of $\eta$ and $\chi$ ($\theta = \pi/2$, $\varphi = 0$), up to the end of creation ($\eta_1 = \ln 0.8$). Every null ray is a straight line at 45°, and the light cone of the origin lies at $\eta \to -\infty$.

expansion_conformal.label: $\eta$ and $\chi$
caption: The plane of $\eta$ and $\chi$ ($\theta = \pi/2$, $\varphi = 0$), from the end of creation ($\eta_1 = \ln 0.8$). Every null ray is a straight line at 45°.
